newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Avon rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Avon rated a buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw reiterated the buy rating for Avon Products Inc.
-- said BusinessWeek magazine recently named Christina Gold, president of Avon's North America division, one of the top 25 managers of the year.
-- said new fragrance and sleepwear products for the designer Natori label promised strong sales.
-- said maintains 1996 earnings of $2.40 per share compared to $2.10 per share last year. For 1997, estimate is $2.77 per share for 1997 and $3.20 per share 1998.
